column3: The web read cache is kept honest by a home revision: an in-memory epoch plus counter bumped by every /v1/cmd batch holding a non-read frame, answered in x-ingle-rev and pushed as {t:"changed",stream:"home",rev}; cached reads also expire after 60 s and are dropped on every socket open. Which ops are cached, live or writes is one table (READS) in web/src/lib/api.ts, and cmd() is the only client entry
column4: Bosun: changes from other tabs, devices and the agent must reach a cached read without a snapshot. XIN-23: pure reads still sent through cmd() dropped the cache, so reopening Settings refetched everything
